title: Ultrasonic Detection Generator
source_docs: Automated Driving Toolbox/Driving Scenario and Sensor Modeling/Ultrasonic_Detection_Generator.md
text: 从驾驶场景或 RoadRunner Scenario 生成超声波传感器检测，输入 1 路、输出 1 路；按 {Target profiles definition} 指定目标配置文件的方法；{Unique identifier of sensor} 指定唯一传感器标识符、{Translation [ X, Y, Z ] relative to ego origin (m)} 指定传感器在自车上的位置、{Rotation [Yaw, Pitch, Roll] relative to ego’s frame (deg)} 指定雷达安装旋转角度、{Field of view [horizontalFOV, verticalFOV] (deg)} 指定超声波传感器的角度视场、{Detection ranges [minDetOnlyRange, minDistRange, maxDistRange] (m)} 指定超声波传感器的检测范围向量、{Update rate (Hz)} 指定传感器更新率、{Source of output bus name} 输出总线名称的来源、{Specify an output bus name} 输出总线名称 BusDrivingRadarData、{MATLAB expression for target profiles} 用于目标配置文件的 MATLAB 表达式 MATLAB、{Unique identifier for actors} 指定场景定义的目标物标识符、{User-defined integer to classify actors} 指定用户定义的分类标识符、{Length of actors’ cuboids (m)} 指定目标物长方体的长度、{Width of actors’ cuboids (m)} 指定目标物长方体的宽度、{Height of actors’ cuboids (m)} 指定目标物长方体的高度、{Rotational center of actors from bottom center (m)} 指定目标物的旋转中心，按实例取值。

ports.name: Actors
ports.summary: 场景参与者位姿 Simulink bus containing MATLAB ® structure

ports.name: Detections
ports.summary: 目标检测 Simulink bus containing MATLAB structure

params.name: Unique identifier of sensor
params.values: 唯一传感器标识符 0 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Translation [ X, Y, Z ] relative to ego origin (m)
params.values: 传感器在自车上的位置 (m) [3.4, 0, 0.2] (default) | 1-by-3 real-valued vector of form [ x y z ]

params.name: Rotation [Yaw, Pitch, Roll] relative to ego’s frame (deg)
params.values: 雷达安装旋转角度 [0 0 0] (default) | 1-by-3 real-valued vector of form [ z yaw y pitch x roll ]

params.name: Field of view [horizontalFOV, verticalFOV] (deg)
params.values: 超声波传感器的角度视场 [70 35] (default) | 1-by-2 positive real-valued vector of form [horizontalFOV verticalFOV]

params.name: Detection ranges [minDetOnlyRange, minDistRange, maxDistRange] (m)
params.values: 超声波传感器的检测范围向量 (m) [0.03 0.15 5.5] (default) | 1-by-3 nonnegative real-valued vector of form [minDetOnlyRange minDistRange maxDistRange]

params.name: Update rate (Hz)
params.values: 传感器更新率 10 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Source of output bus name
params.values: 输出总线名称的来源 Auto (default) | Property

params.name: Specify an output bus name
params.values: 输出总线名称 BusDrivingRadarDataGenerator (default) | valid bus name

params.name: Target profiles definition
params.values: 指定目标配置文件的方法 Parameters (default) | MATLAB expression | From Scenario Reader block

params.name: MATLAB expression for target profiles
params.values: 用于目标配置文件的 MATLAB 表达式 MATLAB structure | MATLAB structure array | valid MATLAB expression

params.name: Unique identifier for actors
params.values: 场景定义的目标物标识符 [] (default) | positive integer | length- L vector of unique positive integers

params.name: User-defined integer to classify actors
params.values: 用户定义的分类标识符 0 (default) | integer | length- L vector of integers

params.name: Length of actors’ cuboids (m)
params.values: 目标物长方体的长度 4.7 (default) | positive real scalar | length- L vector of positive values

params.name: Width of actors’ cuboids (m)
params.values: 目标物长方体的宽度 1.8 (default) | positive real scalar | length- L vector of positive values

params.name: Height of actors’ cuboids (m)
params.values: 目标物长方体的高度 1.4 (default) | positive real scalar | length- L vector of positive values

params.name: Rotational center of actors from bottom center (m)
params.values: 目标物的旋转中心 {[-1.35, 0, 0]} (default) | length- L cell array of real-valued 1-by-3 vectors
